name: copperpour
description: AI-assisted KiCad schematic and PCB design via the Model Context Protocol.
long_description:
Copperpour gives Claude Desktop direct access to KiCad 10 schematics and PCBs through a self-contained local MCP server. Edit schematics with revision-checked atomic writes, lay out and route PCBs in real time over KiCad's IPC API, run ERC/DRC and design reviews, search JLCPCB parts, and export manufacturing outputs.

Prerequisites: KiCad 10 installed locally. PCB layout tools require KiCad running with the board open and Preferences -> Plugins -> Enable KiCad API turned on. Operating guidance is served automatically through MCP instructions, resources, and get_guidance.
